title: CSE turnover falls to lowest level since April 2025
summary:
The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) recorded a turnover of Rs. 722 million on Friday, marking its lowest daily turnover since 17 April 2025.

title: Over 50 lightning related deaths reported annually in Sri Lanka
summary:
Director of the Astronomy and Space Science Unit at the University of Colombo, Professor Chandana Jayaratne, says more than 50 people die annually in Sri Lanka due to lightning strikes.



He stated that many others suffer injuries due to inadequate attention to lightning protection systems.
